== Summary ==
Original slip, 12 January 2004: •A Day Long Remembered (V), as printed on the Players Committee's 12 January 2004 sheet for [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]].

'''Old pre-template slip''' (before the Committee's December 2006 Remaster template).

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040619231451/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf Virtual Set #6 final revised sheet] (Players Committee, “Final Revised Virtual Set 6”, 12 January 2004; AbsolutelyFinalVersion6.pdf on swccgpc.com, Internet Archive capture 19 June 2004; the same file is still hosted as [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards6.pdf VirtualCards6.pdf] on res.starwarsccg.org), page 2, slip 26. The PDF page was rendered at 200 dpi and the slip (with its printed label above it) cut out; nothing else was changed.

Used on: [[A Day Long Remembered (V) (Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds) (Remastered 2006)|A Day Long Remembered (V) (Virtual Set 6) (Errata)]].
